questions.prompt: Does a parent have the right to withdraw a previously given "parental consent" for someone under 18 years of age with respect to an operator's license?
questions.explanation: A parent or guardian who signed consent for an applicant under 18 can withdraw it while that person is still under 18, unless they are self-supporting or married. The licence is then suspended. Key words: "not self-supporting or married".

choices.text: Yes, providing the person is still under the age of 18 and is not self-supporting or married
Yes, provided that both parents verbally agree to withdraw the consent at a registry office
No, once it is given it remains in effect until the person reaches 18 years of age
No, but another consent form must be signed by both parents after a license suspension

questions.prompt: Under the Graduated Driver Licensing program, a driver will receive 2 demerits:
questions.explanation: Learner and probationary drivers may not carry more passengers than there are seat belts in the vehicle. Breaking this GDL condition costs 2 demerit points. Key words: "2 demerits", "seat belts".

choices.text: For having more passengers than there are seat belts
For not wearing a seat belt securely fastened
For not wearing a seat belt
For not wearing a seat belt properly adjusted

questions.prompt: Who is responsible and legally obligated to report any medical condition, change in health, or physical disability that may affect a driver's ability to drive?
questions.explanation: Drivers themselves are legally responsible for reporting any medical condition or disability that may affect their ability to drive safely. Key words: "legally obligated".

choices.text: The driver's employer
The driver
The driver's doctor
The driver's insurance company

questions.prompt: Under the Graduated Driver Licensing program, a learner with a Class 7 operator's license is suspended when they accumulate:
questions.explanation: GDL drivers (learner and probationary) are suspended at 8 demerit points. Fully licensed drivers are suspended at 15. Key words: "a learner", "suspended".

choices.text: 15 demerits
12 demerits
8 demerits
7 demerits

questions.prompt: Under the Graduated Driver Licensing program, what is the minimum amount of time that a person must serve as a probationary Class 5 driver?
questions.explanation: A probationary (Class 5-GDL) driver must hold that licence for at least 2 years, and be suspension-free for the last 12 months, before they can become fully licensed. Key words: "probationary Class 5 driver".

choices.text: 6 months
18 months
2 years
1 year

questions.prompt: A road test will be refused by a driver examiner if:
questions.explanation: An examiner will refuse to conduct a road test in a vehicle that is not mechanically safe, for example one with faulty brakes, lights or signals.

choices.text: The vehicle has a seating capacity greater than 7
The vehicle is registered as a farm vehicle
The vehicle is a rental vehicle
The vehicle is not mechanically safe
